text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no way to execute commands in this session, so please run it to confirm the suite passes. I found each bug by reading the code against the tests.

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` kept the year as a string. It now converts it with `int(year)`.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily rate to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of the `[-n - 1:]` slice. It now uses `[-n:]`, and returns `[]` when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing the third title. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my choice, since the tests only check the title.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, though the comment and tests say five. It is now 5.
